source_note: Compiled from official central-government scheme portals. Rules can change; confirm on the linked official portal before applying.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
schemes.summary: Financial-inclusion programme supporting access to a basic savings bank account.
schemes.eligibility: Indian residents who meet the participating bank's account-opening and KYC requirements.
benefits: RuPay debit card subject to bank process
documents: Identity and address proof accepted by the bank
KYC documents required by the bank

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
schemes.summary: Annual personal accident insurance scheme linked to a participating bank or post-office account.
schemes.eligibility: Account holders aged 18 to 70 years who consent to auto-debit through a participating bank or post office.
benefits: Accident death and full disability cover of Rs 2 lakh
Partial disability cover of Rs 1 lakh, subject to scheme terms
documents: KYC as required by the account provider

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
schemes.summary: Annual renewable life-insurance cover linked to a participating bank or post-office account.
schemes.eligibility: Account holders aged 18 to 50 years who consent to auto-debit through a participating bank or post office; continuation is subject to scheme terms.
benefits: Life cover of Rs 2 lakh on death due to any cause, subject to scheme terms
documents: KYC as required by the account provider

schemes.name: Atal Pension Yojana
schemes.ministry: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority
schemes.summary: Voluntary pension scheme for eligible Indian citizens with a savings bank or post-office savings account.
schemes.eligibility: Indian citizens aged 18 to 40 years with a savings bank or post-office savings account. Income-taxpayer eligibility is subject to the scheme's current rules.
benefits: Guaranteed minimum pension option from Rs 1,000 to Rs 5,000 per month from age 60, subject to contribution and scheme terms
documents: Savings bank or post-office savings account
Aadhaar and mobile number are generally requested for enrolment

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana
schemes.summary: Credit support for eligible non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises through lending institutions.
schemes.eligibility: Eligible non-corporate, non-farm micro or small business activities, subject to lender appraisal and current scheme rules.
benefits: Business loans under Shishu, Kishor, Tarun and Tarun Plus categories, subject to lender approval and current limits
documents: Business and identity documents requested by the lender
Bank statements, quotations, or project details as requested
